<function name="SetLineHeight" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the height of a single line of a <page>RichText</page> panel.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<added>2023.10.25</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="height" type="number">The new line height. Values below zero mean no override.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
